headline: Warden Thrusts Clear Weathered Expanse and Roll Back Palantine Berm
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Warden counter-blows have drastically reshaped the northern battleground, reversing earlier Colonial inroads. In the Weathered Expanse, relentless Warden assaults cleared out remaining Colonial garrisons entirely, bringing seven strategic strongholds under Warden control and leaving two neutral shells amid over three thousand four hundred casualties across the past two hours. Simultaneously, the Colonial salient in Palantine Berm suffered a sharp setback, as Warden forces rolled back previous territorial losses, reclaiming six bases and restricting Colonial tenure to a solitary redoubt across six recent exchanges. Heavy attrition persists unabated across Callahan's Passage, where combat near Crumbling Post swallowed nearly three thousand men in two hours alongside two fresh base contests. To the east, Colonials strengthened their grip on the Stlican Shelf, absorbing the contested gap to claim eight bases against one Warden stronghold. A brief flare-up struck Callum's Cape with four quick changes of hands at Scout's Jest before Warden custody was restored, while fighting along the Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy exacts steady tolls without shifting territorial boundaries.
